rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are presidential letters appointing a Special Assistant to coordinate a cross-agency policy field, followed by authority to establish a representative coordinating body, obtain staff, organize temporary task forces, form working relationships with related organizations, and attend relevant meetings. Several clauses are unusually close in wording and sequence. C03 and C10 share public-works or resources-planning machinery and intergovernmental coordination, but their textual and structural correspondence is less extensive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby appoint you as Special Assistant to the President to serve as coordinator of public works planning.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Effective immediately I am designating you as Special Assistant to the President ... to assure the effective coordination of foreign economic matters of concern to the several departments and agencies of the Executive Branch.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters appoint a Special Assistant as the President's coordinator for a policy area spanning multiple agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You are also authorized to establish an Advisory Committee on Public Works to include persons designated by the Secretaries ... and by the heads of such other Federal agencies responsible for public works as may be necessary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You are authorized to establish and to serve as the chairman, of a Council on Foreign Economic Policy through which executive agencies can participate effectively in this undertaking.... The heads of other departments and agencies should be invited by the chairman to participate ... when matters of direct concern to them are under consideration.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish an interagency coordinating body with specified core representation and flexible participation by other relevant agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You may provide yourself with such staff as is necessary to assist you in the performance of these duties. You are authorized to organize temporary task forces made up of personnel from the various Federal departments and agencies.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You may provide yourself with such staff as is necessary to assist you in connection with these duties. In addition, I anticipate that from time to time provision will need to be made for a limited number of special task forces for the review of specific foreign economic matters.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive near-verbatim language coupling authority for necessary staff with temporary or special task forces.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You are requested to attend the meetings of Federal Government committees or interdepartmental groups which may deal with public works problems.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The achievement of such integration will be furthered by your attendance at such meetings of those organizations as you consider necessary.
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the Special Assistant to attend meetings of related interagency organizations as part of the coordinating role.
